LTM is Hiring AI/ML Professionals




Join LTM and be part of a team that's building the future with Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and next-generation technologies.




Open Skill Areas

AI/ML, Data Science & Python
Experience with Python, Machine Learning, Data Science, and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, GCP, Snowflake, or Databricks.

Generative AI & LLMs
Hands-on experience with Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, Prompt Engineering, LangChain, and AI-powered applications.

MLOps Engineering
Expertise in MLOps, model deployment, automation, monitoring, CI/CD pipelines, and Python-based ML workflows




# Required Skills

Python Programming
Machine Learning & Deep Learning
Data Science & Analytics
Generative AI (GenAI)
Large Language Models (LLMs)
NLP & Prompt Engineering
LangChain, RAG, Agentic AI
AWS, Azure, GCP, Snowflake, or Databricks
MLOps (Preferred)



#Why Join?

Work on next-generation AI technologies
Continuous learning and career growth opportunities
Collaborative and innovation-driven culture
Opportunity to contribute to impactful enterprise projects
Exposure to large-scale AI transformation initiatives




If you're passionate about AI, Machine Learning, Data Science, Generative AI, and MLOps, we'd love to connect with you.

AI Engineer | ML Engineer | Data Scientist | GenAI Engineer | LLM Engineer | NLP Engineer | MLOps Engineer | Python Developer | Machine Learning | Deep Learning | Generative AI | Agentic AI | RAG | LangChain | Data Science | Artificial Intelligence
